en.askTitle: Put your own family, visa route and school plan into the boxes and get the same Lisbon move check
en.runTitle: Toronto to Lisbon: a family of four, D7 or D8 visa, from September 2027

fields.label: Arrival date
fields.value: September 2027, for at least two years

fields.label: Passports and family relationships
fields.value: Canadian citizens, a family of four: two parents and two children

fields.label: Children’s ages, birthdays and completed grades
Portuguese-language needs
fields.placeholder: e.g. neither child speaks Portuguese yet; both would need language support in school

fields.label: Employer approval and gross income
fields.value: Remote product manager for a Toronto company, CAD 165,000 a year

fields.label: Freelance income
fields.value: One parent works as a freelance graphic designer

fields.label: Savings and Canadian home costs
fields.placeholder: e.g. CAD 150,000 in savings and a Toronto home that will be rented out

fields.label: School preference
fields.value: Comparing international and Portuguese public schools in Lisbon, Cascais or Oeiras

en.template: Plan our Toronto-to-Lisbon move for {arrival} with {family}, children aged {children}, {language}, {employer}, {freelance}, {savings} and {school}. Compare linked D8 family applications, public-school support and a fully quoted international alternative. Build first-year cash flow with taxes, contributions, deposits and upfront school bills separated. Flag unconfirmed Toronto requirements and future fees. Ask before contacting anyone, submitting forms, sharing personal information or paying.

phases.title: Read the official immigration, school, housing and tax sources
phases.note: Visa rules, school enrolment and fees, rents, tax residency and health cover
phases.judgment: It used the wage figure that is actually law today (€920 for 2026) and marked the announced 2027 figure (€970) as not yet confirmed. It also dropped an outdated assurance: the first residence permit now takes up to 90 days to decide, with no automatic approval.

phases.title: Build the guide and the first-year budget in euros and Canadian dollars
phases.note: Visa recommendation, timeline, school comparison and cash flow with the arithmetic shown

phases.title: Independent check of every figure, plus desktop and phone layout
phases.judgment: The reviewer recomputed all 22 budget rows and found no numerical errors. It also said which claims it could not confirm independently, the public-school enrolment steps, so those stay marked as unconfirmed.

workers: Read the official consulate, immigration, minimum-wage and Canadian document sources for the D7 and D8 visas and for family applications
Checked how Portuguese public-school enrolment works, then collected dated fee schedules from three international schools and sample 3-bedroom rents
Collected the official sources on tax residency, working for a Toronto employer from Portugal, social security and health cover
Independently recomputed every money figure and checked the guide’s claims against the source list
